summary: CadastreAI final metrics (Task 4.18). Retrieval evaluated against the honest synth split (n=40); agent evaluated against agent_queries.jsonl (n=30) with Claude-as-judge faithfulness.
caveats: Small eval sets: at n=40 one query moves recall by 0.025, at n=30 one query moves agent metrics by ~0.03. Adjacent configurations within one query of each other should be read as ties.

metric_notes.mean_groundedness: Strict regex formatting-contract check: % of numeric tokens with a citation literal within 50 characters. NOT an answer-quality measure — the synthesizer often cites at end of sentence, which the judge accepts and this regex does not. mean_faithfulness is the load-bearing quality number. See docs/report_v2.md section 3b.
metric_notes.mean_faithfulness: Claude-as-judge, whole-answer claim support against retrieved evidence and tool results. Deductions are partial-support cases, not fabrications.

deployment.smoke_test: 3/5 PASS on content + latency; 2/5 correct cited answers, latency over 45s budget on local CPU
